sourceFile: 21. MSU-L20S15-07GMI  Report Test Supension partially modify the  C.L thicknees and modify the entire C.L_clean.xlsx

aiVerification.summary: The draft has citeable evidence but the changed-factor and outcome grouping are too noisy for final Ask AI use.
issues: Primary changed factor mixes true C/L thickness changes with totals, flux notes, and defect labels.
526top and test sheets may represent distinct validation contexts and are merged without clear grouping.
Several measurement outcomes are header-derived or misclassified process/function defect tables.
Comparable grouping keys are incomplete for type A/B, flux condition, model/side, and test round.
Most outcomes remain not_judged despite available normal and modified condition rows.
requiredUserQuestions: Should 526top and test sheets be one review case or separate cases?
Is bonding flux a subgroup/confounder or part of the tested change?
correctionPlan: Define primary factor as Normal vs partially modified C/L thickness vs entire/all-part C/L thickness, excluding totals and flux notes.
Separate or explicitly subgroup 526top X526 results from MSU-L20S1507 results if contexts differ.
Remove spurious header/statistical measurement outcomes and keep only real defect, function, and tension outcomes.
Rebuild comparisons within matching type, flux, model/side, and test-round keys.
Assign judgements with concise limitations for small sample size and any unmatched rows.
aiVerification.evidencePolicy: Row IDs exist, but citations are not sufficient until header/data alignment and comparable condition grouping are corrected.
